topic: Using an AI chatbot to summarize a long article or document into a few plain sentences
headline: Let AI Summarize The Long Stuff
supporting_text: Paste the text into an AI chat app and ask for a short summary in plain language.
caption:
⚡ TODAY’S 30-SECOND TECH WIN

Some articles, emails, or notices are just long. You don’t have time to read every word, but you still want the main point.

An AI chatbot can help shorten it for you. Copy the text, paste it into an AI chat app, and type something like “Summarize this in 3 simple sentences.”

In a few seconds, you’ll have the main idea in plain language, without wading through paragraphs you don’t need.

This works well for news articles, long work emails, or community updates you just want the gist of.

Save this tip for later.

Follow @DigitalCalmDaily for one simple 30-Second Tech Win every day.
